messages.author: Ingrid Voss
messages.text: The staging dedup run failed Thursday night on a lock timeout, so the re-sent batch went straight through. The dedup audit table has the exact duplicate count — use that, not the delivery header.

messages.author: Rei Tanaka
messages.text: STD's night window tonight is free; a dedup rerun fits it easily. Thursday's windows are already spoken for.

messages.author: Femi Oyelaran
messages.text: The published snapshot must tie to Corin's statement before she signs. Any expedite fee to Bluecrest goes through Ingrid.
